Each file is the EXACT upstream file from the VS Code repository at the pinned commit; `sha256` and `bytes` pin it. Re-fetch and verify: `npm run grammars:verify` (scripts/fetch-grammars.mjs). Only grammars that the editor's TextMate-lite tokenizer handles well are here (ui-app/src/features/ext/domain/textmate.ts); the ones left out, and why, are listed in CLAUDE.md («Sem servidor de linguagem»).
